content:
Ravi: Quick thought: saved queries in Console should show a "simulated results" mode when route sampling/quotas are active so people don't get surprised.

Sana: Agreed. Proposal: saved query stores a tiny `ui_hint` blob (opaque) like `{sample:0.2, pin_model: "test-redwood"}` used only for previews.

Theo: Backend preview endpoint: POST /api/queries/preview -> returns sample_count, token_est, applied_hint. Must be rate-limited and auth-checked.

Ravi: UX: small pill "Simulated (est. cost: 12 tokens)" with hover showing p50/p95 latency and last computed time. If stats >24h old show "stale".

Sana: Important: microcopy must say "This preview simulates quota/routing fallbacks and does not change live routing."

AlertBot: Note: design sync in 10.

Theo: I'll spike the endpoint today. We'll store hints as string blobs to avoid coupling routing logic.

Ravi: Also add "Compare variants" button to see no-fallback vs narrow vs sampled. Small diffs only.

Sana: Sounds good. I'll draft the modal copy and mock.

Theo: Will add auth + rate-limit and log preview usage to telemetry.

Ravi: Perfect, confirm in design sync.
